properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: MD5 in active use in a security protocol: DaemonRpc (cw_core/lib/node.dart:640-650) performs HTTP Digest Authentication against wallet daemon RPC, and md5Hash (line 633-635) computes the RFC 7616 MD5 response/HA1 hashes for those credentials. Collision-broken hash inside an auth protocol; also the cnonce it relies on is generated by math.Random (ALG-7d1fdc12). Changeable here — migrate daemon login to SHA-256 digest auth where the daemon supports it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Bitcoin/Litecoin/BitcoinCash/Dogecoin wallet keys: BIP32-SLIP10 HD derivation, ECDSA transaction signing, pubkey recovery and low-S normalization over secp256k1 — the wallet's core signing surface. The curve is fixed by each blockchain protocol: observable here, replaceable only by the chains themselves; a PQ wallet would need protocol-level changes (no secp256k1 PQ migration exists today).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 dependency set (ed25519_edwards, ed25519_hd_key declared in every coin package's pubspec_overrides.yaml) plus Monero/Zano seed derivation using the ed25519 curve order. Ed25519 signs Solana/Nano/Tron transactions and underpins Monero/Zano addresses — protocol-fixed curves, observable here, replaceable only by those chains. Shor-vulnerable.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Two PBKDF2 instantiations in the app: Electrum-v2 mnemonic seed derivation (2048 iterations, HMAC-SHA512 — standard-fixed) and the iOS/macOS legacy decryption key (4096 iterations, HMAC-SHA256 — weakly parameterized, feeds Blowfish). properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HMAC-SHA512 keyed with 'Seed version' identifies Electrum-v2 mnemonics and derives version hashes — a MAC over seed material in the Bitcoin-family seed handling. Quantum-safe (Grover only halves HMAC strength).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 (hashlib) actively hashes secrets.walletGroupSalt + wallet seed/primary address to derive a stable wallet-group identifier. Quantum-safe digest. Note kDebugMode returns "$combined;$digest" — seed concatenated into the identifier in debug builds; the hash itself is sound.
